state.objective: The intended authors are AI agents, even if humans find the language harsh. Prioritize correct programs and safe modifications; count complete successful-task tokens second. No external adopter requires migration compatibility. Lower equivalent behavior to native JS/Bun with minimal contract-preserving adaptation. This evaluation guides future work and confers no implemented capability.
state.error_evidence: The existing declaration error 1000000 payment_declined(str reason) allocates its integer again in project registry data. Loading, checking and runtime admission enforce global numeric exclusivity, even against another project’s retirement list. Nominal dispatch and assertion comparison already distinguish resolved declaration identity and generic specialization. Unhandled failure reports expose id alongside typeIdentity and redact payloads. Audited consumers establish neither bare-number lookup across builds nor numeric continuity after renaming. Either redesign touches graph and lock, checks, emission, runtime, diagnostics and tests; catalogue-owned numeric tags can stay internal.
state.error_contract: The selected scheme must let independently authored libraries link unchanged without negotiating identifiers. Owner separation, generic error distinctions, redacted reporting and reproducibility are mandatory. Explain canonical ownership and rename/retirement policy; relocation cannot affect identity, and unrelated graph growth cannot merge errors. Reports from both old and new locked builds must remain interpretable using promised artifacts. Any optional short integer belongs to its identified build and retained reverse mapping, never replacing nominal type identity.
state.action_evidence: Current Can can centralize URLs, rendering and status selection, decode a shallow raw record and return finite outcome cases. Its 18-assertion invoice experiment is source-only evidence, without HTTP/database/browser observation or protected-effect verification. Generic URL safety and target typing lack exact route ownership, while field names and duplicated mount/request literals admit unchecked drift. The two linked-contract candidates promise the same checks; neither has an implementation or held-out agent result. Both incur compiler/catalogue/emitter plus native-adapter work. Present static descriptor validation is only an analogy.
state.action_contract: The bounded feature is a POST at /invoice/edit using invoice_key query data and raw invoice_form members, capped at 2048 bytes. Map saved, invalid, conflict, forbidden and unavailable to genuine 200, 422, 409, 403 and 503 responses with declared inner replacement. Canonical package instance plus action declaration joins construction, method, mount, input and complete case mapping. Direct wire-field references carry ownership and exact types, and strict form parsing rejects duplicate or unknown fields. Such checking cannot guarantee permissions, an existing target, durable writes or safe retries. Server handlers still enforce actor/CSRF and tenant/revision protections; real DOM and database observations are required. Browser compilation excludes mount. Captured paths, nested forms, component syntax and render-scope targets are independently scoped.
state.action_tradeoffs: Putting action beside Can types requires parser support for a declaration and its sections, export/resolution of static symbols and catalogue consumers; it must restrict those symbols from mutable general data. JSON placement avoids that grammar while requiring symbol-aware manifest checking, generated package APIs and rules for collisions, private types, ownership and precise key diagnostics. Its symbol lookup uses the declaring project’s dependencies and generated URL/post/mount calls retain the same checked semantics. Keeping only helper functions costs no new mechanism, yet endpoint identity and loose string consistency remain discipline/test obligations. Comparative creation, edit and error-repair tasks must include the strongest centralized helpers; no token benefit has been established.

application_error_identity.instructions: Select the better future error declaration/reporting design for agent-authored libraries using the consumer evidence and identity obligations supplied here.

criteria.qualified_text: Choose an unnumbered declaration, error payment_declined(str reason), and remove application active-number bookkeeping. Report resolved qualified owner/declaration identities with generic arguments. A rename denotes a different error and historical reports retain their build interpretation; optional integer compaction needs an archived build mapping. State textual-name retirement and reuse rules separately from active source declarations.
criteria.owner_number: Keep error 1000000 payment_declined(str reason), but scope the number ledger to its owner. Foreign active or retired values do not collide. Emit owner identity, local code and concrete type arguments together, preserving each owner’s numeric continuity and tombstones while maintaining both authored declaration and registry allocation.

action_contract_placement.instructions: Choose the planned surface for exact endpoint, form and finite-response linking, using the common contract and present evidence rather than human familiarity or untested brevity claims.

criteria.source_action: Author the linked contract in Can beside the wire and outcome types via new action syntax. Export its static identity for action::url, action::post and action::mount. Supply the same method, route, form and exhaustive status checks as the manifest candidate, test against centralized helpers and defer optional capture design.
criteria.checked_manifest: Place the action table in a symbol-checked manifest section, resolved in its owner’s environment, and generate save_invoice_url/save_invoice_post/save_invoice_mount members. Preserve all shared route, form and response checks while avoiding action grammar; benchmark the centralized baseline and gate captures separately.
criteria.ordinary_helpers: Keep the factored helper approach as the planned mechanism, backed by protocol/DOM/storage tests. Add neither source actions nor checked manifest synthesis yet, explicitly leaving endpoint identity and string consistency outside compile-time checks until additional comparative evidence warrants them.
